headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with AI‑led firms posting strong gains while legacy players saw modest or declining results.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from sub‑2% at Infosys to over 50% at Coforge. AI revenue contributed materially for several firms, boosting margins at HCLTech and TCS. Dividend payouts were stable but varied, reflecting divergent profit trends. Guidance was trimmed at Infosys but raised by Mphasis and Coforge.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: AI revenue grew 29% YoY at Infosys and 47% YoY at LTM, underpinning large‑deal wins and profit expansion.

themes.title: Margin expansion
themes.detail: Coforge lifted FY27 EBIT margin guidance to 16% and HCLTech reported an operating margin of 18.2% despite modest revenue growth.

themes.title: Dividend stability
themes.detail: Most companies maintained or modestly increased dividends, with Infosys at Rs 26 and LTM at Rs 25 per share.
